newsitem.title: HONG KONG: United Pac buys control of HK Toy Centre.
newsitem.headline: United Pac buys control of HK Toy Centre.

text.p: Hong Kong Toy Centre International Ltd said on Friday its controlling shareholders Victor Lo and Esther Leung had agreed to sell a 47.27 percent stake to Pacific Margin International Ltd.
The toy maker said Lo and Leung had agreed to sell a total 166.76 million company shares to Pacific Margin for HK$150.09 million, representing HK$0.90 per share.
Pacific Margin is a unit of United Pacific Industries Ltd, a voltage converters, coils, rechargeable batteries and telecom equipment maker.
Hong Kong Toy Centre said Pacific Margin would be required to make a general offer for all outstanding shares of the company on completion of the deal on April 11.
Lo and Leung held about 47 percent of Hong Kong Toy Centre as in September 1996.
Trading in shares of Hong Kong Toy Centre and United Pacific which was suspended on Wednesday and Thursday respectively, would remain suspended pending a detail announcement.
